summary: Implemented push-only gh authentication with process-scoped Git config, GH_CONFIG_DIR, and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0. Direct gh and non-push environments remain isolated; no HOME/token/config write exists. Typecheck and 17 focused delivery tests pass, and a production-function dry run authenticated while the remote probe ref stayed absent and all persistent Git config digests stayed stable.

state.request: Fix the live 0.24.0 release blocker discovered during protected delivery: the built-in sanitized HTTPS git push must authenticate through the host's existing GitHub CLI configuration using an ephemeral narrowly scoped Git credential-helper bridge, without inheriting HOME, reading or persisting tokens, changing persistent Git configuration, weakening exact argv, or affecting non-push commands. Add regression and live-boundary verification, deliver the fix and evidence through protected pull requests to main, and prepare but do not publish 0.24.0 or modify any VPS.
